video_title: Brian Windhorst on how the Celtics will operate without Jaylen Brown | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics are shifting toward a deep, youth-focused roster strategy
quotes.excerpt: Celtics are trying to totally remake their team for the modern league
quotes.quote: The Celtics are trying to totally remake their team for the modern league, which is not necessarily top-heavy with superstar players getting paid a lot of money, although I know Paul George is getting paid a lot of money alongside Jayson Tatum. But to have a lot of depth that they can rely on to use a lot of different formations, a lot of different lineups, get better efficiency for their dollars. The Celtics are trying a new way of doing things and it's not just going to be Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown. They are going to rely on Payton Pritchard more, they are going to rely on Baylor Scheierman more, they are going to rely on Hugo Gonzalez, and even Mitchell Robinson and Neemias Queta, who they just resigned.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics and Jaylen Brown are moving on without apparent animosity
quotes.excerpt: There doesn't seem to be animosity. Sometimes splits are hard amongst coaches and players
quotes.quote: There doesn't seem to be animosity. Sometimes splits are hard amongst coaches and players or players and players and teams, and it just seems like both people are happy to start these new chapters in some ways. I know it was not as easy or expected, but it just happened and they're on to better places, respectively, in their careers.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Scrutiny shifts to Boston's roster construction around Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: Now the scrutiny is in some ways on Boston because you chose, you have JT as the guy
quotes.quote: Now the scrutiny is in some ways on Boston because you chose, you have JT as the guy coming off of injury, you are building around more so role players. You want to build more with Derek White as well as the other top-caliber guy in their backcourt, in their frontcourt as well. And so I'm curious on how this system really helps those others shine because there will be a lot of eyeballs.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic is excited about the Lakers' recent roster moves
quotes.excerpt: He's excited about the moves that they made. Now recognizes that there's a lot of work ahead
quotes.quote: I checked in with someone close to Luka Doncic who told me in a word he's excited about the moves that they made. Now recognizes that there's a lot of work ahead of them, but feels like this is going to give the requisite kind of wind behind his own sails to march towards the championship. He needs to step into a further leadership role with this team.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney's addition provides necessary center depth for Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Kevon Looney was another backup that they added that they needed. They needed a backup center
quotes.quote: Kevon Looney was another backup that they added that they needed. They needed a backup center. He had some opportunities around the league. I spoke to someone close to him today who said that he saw it as a clear opportunity. He saw a parallel between the some of the half-court sets that they're going to run and the way he can free up Luka Doncic and AR the same way he freed up Klay and Steph with screens.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers are aggressively pursuing Jonathan Kuminga in free agency
quotes.excerpt: One guy they're speaking to, Anthony Slater has been all over it, Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.quote: One guy they're speaking to, Anthony Slater has been all over it, Jonathan Kuminga. And right now he's without a team. Now Atlanta turned down their team option of $24 million for him this year. The Lakers currently don't have anywhere close to that to offer them. They would have to do some maneuvering, perhaps doing another trade, use those two second-round picks that they got from Washington in the Ayton deal to maybe attach someone like a Dalton Knecht or Jared Vanderbilt to a trade to free up some cap space to give him a better offer than the veteran minimum.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers successfully addressed their two biggest offseason roster needs
quotes.excerpt: They had to keep Austin Reaves, they did that. They had to get a starting front-line center
quotes.quote: The two things they had to do going to the off-season, they had to keep Austin Reaves, they did that. They had to get a starting front-line center that matched with Luka Doncic, they did that. Both were expensive, but they got those done. Those were the big strokes.
